# ============================================================================
# CANDIDATES, NOT SOURCES. Nothing in this file is crawled.
#
# These 119 Pinpoint tenant slugs were recovered by a research pass in a
# container with no outbound access to job boards, so not one of them was probed
# by this project. docs/adding-a-source.md is explicit that a slug nobody has
# verified must not be registered, and at this project's fan-out a dead tenant is
# not free: it burns a request every crawl, reports as a failing source, and
# enough of them together trip the Source Health workflow's 35%-failure alarm,
# which is the signal that is supposed to mean a real platform broke.
#
# 34 slugs are registered in internal/services/pinpoint.go as
# PinpointCompanies: 33 from this file's two hand-curated batches, plus
# "surrealdb", whose provenance is this repository's own docs/source-backlog.md
# rather than this file. The rest are staged here until a CI job — the only
# place in this project with real network access — can probe them. The section
# merged by "discovery/merge.py" carries "?" where the employer name should be;
# none of those is registered.
#
# Promotion rule, gated on content and not on status code: keep a slug whose
# https://<slug>.pinpointhq.com/postings.json answers 200 with a JSON object
# carrying a "data" array of length above zero, and whose postings carry a
# "title" and a "url" at the top level of each element rather than nested under
# an "attributes" object — that nesting would mean the feed had moved to a
# JSON:API envelope, which the adapter does not read.
#
# The verification claims and posting counts below are the upstream curator's,
# dated as annotated. They are recorded as provenance, not endorsed.
# ============================================================================
#
# Pinpoint (pinpointhq.com) tenant slugs -- one per line (# = comment, inline OK).
# Public keyless JSON: https://{slug}.pinpointhq.com/postings.json -> {"data":[...]}
# (full descriptions inline, single call, no detail march). Each is live-verified
# (HTTP 200 + non-empty data array) before adding. SMB/scale-up segment.
